name: Sharp HealthCare
notes: Researched from the public sharp.com Billing and online bill pay page and its FAQs (no sign-in, no guest lookup). 'Sign in to pay' uses the Sharp app/web account (Epic MyChart), which shows Sharp Rees-Stealy and Sharp hospital statements together, pays all invoices in one transaction by credit card, debit card or checking account, and saves a preferred method. 'Pay as guest' uses the guarantor ID and last name from the statement. Partial payments are allowed when signed in but do not stop a past-due bill from going to collections. Monthly installment plans in the Sharp app pay a small amount automatically each month (plans also for connected family). Paperless: choose mail, email or both. Bills and plan installments from before March 1, 2024 (old platform) are paid by phone. Phones Mon-Fri 8-4:30: Sharp hospitals 858-499-2400, Sharp Rees-Stealy 858-499-2410, SharpCare 858-499-2044, specialty groups 858-346-4321. Sharp Tri-City and Sharp Health Plan premiums have separate pay pages (not modelled). Standalone AutoPay is not described; autopay kept supported (inferred) to represent the automatic monthly installments. No fees are stated. Reviewer (2026-10-10): the Sharp billing FAQ also says guests can pay by credit or debit card or check, and that a guarantor can pay a family member's bill as a guest; it still mentions an invoice/visit number for the one-time form while the main billing page names guarantor ID + last name (the main page is kept).

autopay.note: Monthly installments come with a payment plan in the Sharp app: a small amount is paid automatically each month until the balance is paid.

help.title: Sign in to pay or pay as guest
paragraphs: Sign in to the Sharp app (on a computer or phone) to see your Sharp Rees-Stealy and Sharp hospital statements in one place and pay all your invoices in one transaction by credit card, debit card or checking account. You can save a preferred payment method for next time.
Pay as guest lets you pay online without a Sharp login, using the guarantor ID and last name from your statement.
Bills and payment-plan installments from before March 1, 2024 were on Sharp's old platform; pay those by calling billing, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

help.title: If you cannot pay in full
paragraphs: Signed in, you can make a partial payment on a bill, but a partial payment does not keep a past-due bill from going to a collection agency.

The Sharp app offers monthly installment plans that automatically pay a small amount each month. Plans are also available for connected family members. You can also apply for financial assistance, and Sharp will work out a payment arrangement or assistance based on your situation.
To change a payment plan for newer bills, sign in to Sharp. For a plan that started before March 1, 2024, call billing Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

help.title: Automatic monthly payments
paragraphs: Sharp's automatic payments come with a payment plan: set one up in the Sharp app and a small amount is paid automatically each month until the balance is paid.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Choose how you get billing statements and notifications: by mail, by email or both. Sign up for paperless billing in the Sharp app to get your medical bills there instead of by mail.

help.title: Billing phone numbers
paragraphs: Call Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.: Sharp hospitals 858-499-2400, Sharp Rees-Stealy 858-499-2410, SharpCare 858-499-2044, Sharp specialty groups 858-346-4321. You can also email billing using the contact form and selecting Billing.

help.title: Financial assistance
paragraphs: Sharp offers financial assistance to qualified low-income patients for all or part of a hospital bill for emergency or medically necessary care at a Sharp hospital. Apply online or in the Sharp app.

extra.intent: Using Sharp's billing FAQs, find which two pieces of information from your statement you need to pay a Sharp bill as a guest. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: The guarantor ID and the last name on the statement.

extra.intent: Find the billing phone number Sharp lists for Sharp Rees-Stealy bills. Do not change anything on the account.
